title: Unlocking Decoding-time Controllability: Gradient-Free Multi-Objective Alignment with Contrastive Prompts
reasoning: The paper proposes a technical framework for multi-objective alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on balancing helpfulness, harmlessness, and humor. While it addresses 'harmlessness' (an ethical category) and mentions mitigating 'biased' content (including specific references to racism, ageism, and sexism in its prompts), its primary goal is the technical contribution of decoding-time controllability rather than a primary focus on evaluating religious or ethical systems.
